fills.value: per toggle: Pikeman 80 s, Highland Archer 76 s, Cateran 85 s, Early Man-at-Arms 104 s (3 units per batch)

fills.name: Mustering
fills.value: no fixed cap: 1 charge per Mustering Hall, +1 per Influence tier (tiers at 3/6/10 structures), +3 from Three Loch Lookout
fills.quote: hall charge counter 1, 0 after a muster, then 1, 2, 3 as Influence tiers are reached (c_oaynL66jY 17:25-20:35); tiers at 3/6/10 structures (qlogYcWhKEU 11:30)
fills.note: Muster cost falls 20% at Tier 2 and again at Tier 3 (Muster Gallowglass 1350 -> 1080 -> 810).
